about_the_game:
You move in the dark, your echoes follow.

They move only when you do. Every step brings you closer to survival or death in this horror FPS game.

As an officer on duty, you’re sent to investigate a mysterious emergency call and you find yourself in the middle of nowhere...

But what you find is an abandoned graveyard swallowed by shadows... and something is waiting for you in the dark.

Features

  • Outsmart terrifying creatures that move when you move. Conserve ammo, get creative, and use traps to survive.

  • A forgotten cult. Lost faith. The answers are buried deep in chilling puzzles left behind by those who came before you.

  • Health and ammo are scarce. Explore carefully, survival may depend on what you find... and what you don’t.

  • Uncover long-buried secrets and find out what really happened here: you may end up staying here for something completely different than what you came for

Will you walk into the dark… and face what stirs in the tall grass?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent scenes of violence involving shooting and killing supernatural creatures. Players will encounter dead bodies of police officers in the environment, including one instance where a body is visibly cut in half. However, the game does not include graphic gore or detailed internal organs.

There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual violence, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500 @3.3 GHz / AMD FX-8320 @3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 560 Ti / AMD Radeon™ HD 6870 (1GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: A horror FPS where monsters only move when you do. As the officer on duty, you’re dispatched to investigate an emergency call. But what awaits is an abandoned graveyard steeped in darkness and terror. Solve cryptic puzzles, uncover long-buried secrets, and fight to escape the cursed grounds.
